proposedTopics.title: Web3 / Solidity / DeFi
proposedTopics.description: Root of the Web3 learning path: fundamentals → Solidity → tooling → standards → gas → security → DeFi → EVM internals → frontier → full-stack. Code-first — every leaf has a Build task in the web3-practice repo and a Done-when gate; security threads from Phase 4 and is exhaustive in Phase 6. Study one leaf at a time.
proposedTopics.aiContext: path root, created 2026-07-07. Approach B (phased spiral, woven security). Toolchain: Foundry-primary + Hardhat 3 for TS deploy/full-stack. Extend via living-roadmap prompting.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 1 — Blockchain & Ethereum Fundamentals
proposedTopics.description: How Ethereum works: accounts, transactions, gas, the EVM, PoS consensus, L2s/rollups, account abstraction, and the 2025–26 protocol state (Pectra/Fusaka). Mostly theory; entry point.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 2 — Solidity Language
proposedTopics.description: The Solidity language end to end: types, storage, functions, inheritance, events, errors, low-level calls, ABI, signatures, assembly intro.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 3 — Tooling: Foundry & Hardhat
proposedTopics.description: Foundry (primary: test/fuzz/invariant/gas/security) and Hardhat 3 (secondary: TS deploy pipelines, full-stack), plus their interop.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 4 — Core Contract Patterns & Standards
proposedTopics.description: Token standards (ERC-20/721/1155/4626), proxies/upgradeability, access control, signatures/permit/meta-tx, airdrops, multisig, factories, DAOs — each with its threat model.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 5 — Gas Optimization
proposedTopics.description: Exhaustive gas: storage packing, warm/cold access, calldata, unchecked, bitmaps, custom errors, assembly, architecture.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 6 — Security & Auditing
proposedTopics.description: The full attack taxonomy + audit methodology, static analysis, fuzzing/invariants, report writing, wargames (Ethernaut, Damn Vulnerable DeFi v4), real-exploit replays, and CodeHawks First Flights.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 7 — DeFi Mechanics & From-Scratch Builds
proposedTopics.description: Build DeFi from scratch: AMMs, Uniswap V2→V3→V4, lending, stablecoins, oracles, staking/restaking, perps, vaults, flash loans.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 8 — EVM Internals & Advanced Solidity
proposedTopics.description: Opcodes, Yul/Huff, storage/memory/calldata at the bytecode level, proxies at bytecode level, formal verification.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 9 — Frontier Strands
proposedTopics.description: MEV, intents/ERC-7683, Uniswap V4 hooks, restaking, RWAs, ZK, L2 internals. Independently orderable after Phase 7.

proposedTopics.title: Phase 10 — Full-Stack dApp
proposedTopics.description: viem/wagmi, wallet connection, reading/writing contracts, events/indexing, Scaffold-ETH 2, the Speedrun Ethereum challenge ladder.
